messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
After about an hour into walking around my eye screen fogged up due to the heat and I couldn't see much of anything so for the last hour whenever we moved I had to be led by the hand.

output.original_text: After about an hour into walking around my eye screen fogged up due to the heat and I couldn't see much of anything so for the last hour whenever we moved I had to be led by the hand.
output.joy: After about an hour into walking around, my eye screen fogged up due to the heat, but I didn't mind being led by the hand for the last hour as we explored together!
output.sadness: After about an hour into walking around, my eye screen fogged up due to the heat, and I felt so helpless as I struggled to see; for the last hour, I had to rely on someone to lead me by the hand.
output.fear: After about an hour into walking around, my eye screen fogged up due to the heat, and panic set in since I couldn't see much; for the last hour, I was scared and had to be led by the hand.
output.anger: After about an hour into walking around, my eye screen fogged up from the heat and I was fuming about not being able to see anything; it was infuriating to need to be led by the hand for the last hour.
output.surprise: After about an hour into walking around, my eye screen fogged up due to the heat, and I was surprised at how quickly I lost visibility; for the last hour, I oddly found myself needing to be led by the hand!
output.disgust: After about an hour into walking around, my eye screen fogged up from the heat, and it was truly unpleasant not being able to see anything; for the last hour, I felt gross needing to be led by the hand.
